snapshot_source: Live tool list observed in a Claude Code session on 2026-09-02

tools.name: get-bill
tools.description: One bill: number, title, status and progress, chamber, session, and sponsors with party and district.

tools.name: get-bill-documents
tools.description: A bill's texts, amendments, and supplements. Each carries a meeting_document_id readable through get-document.

tools.name: get-bill-events
tools.description: Scheduled hearings and floor votes for a bill, with date, time, and room.

tools.name: get-bill-status-changes
tools.description: Merged status timeline for a bill. Filter event_kind == "history" for official status changes; major: true flags the big moves.

tools.name: get-document
tools.description: One document by ID. Also serves legislation documents, which carry organization_id: null and a bill_id.

tools.name: get-meeting
tools.description: Metadata, video URL, and cloverleaf_url for one meeting ID.

tools.name: get-meeting-transcripts
tools.description: Full transcript for one meeting. Large, and reserved for opportunity-enrichment on shortlisted signals.

tools.name: list-contacts
tools.description: Role-keyed civic contact roster (name, title, email, direct phone) by organization or geography.

tools.name: list-organization-meetings
tools.description: Walk one jurisdiction's meetings newest-first. The preferred single-entity tool.

tools.name: lookup-organization
tools.description: Resolve a jurisdiction name to a numeric organization ID. Returns meeting_count and last_published_at per match; embedding-ranked, so read the whole list.

tools.name: run-document-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical agenda, packet, and procurement text search. states works (verified ["TX"], 186 hits). sortBy accepts hits or meeting_date, with direction.

tools.name: run-legislation-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical search over bill texts, amendments, and supplements.

tools.name: run-meeting-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical transcript search with anchor terms (mustIncludeTerms plus proximity). perPage up to 100 with real page pagination; the old 25-meeting cap is gone.

tools.name: run-purchase-keyword-search
tools.description: Lexical keyword search over the same purchase records; `terms` must be an array (same shape as run-meeting-keyword-search). Parameter schema not published by the server as of 2026-09-02.

tools.name: search-campaigns
tools.description: Saved campaigns as search-spec templates. Read-only, and the payload arrives inline.

tools.name: search-documents
tools.description: Semantic natural-language search over meeting documents. The intent-based procurement finder; returns per-chunk score and per-document best_score.

tools.name: search-insights
tools.description: Already-generated AI insights with Signal Match scores. Free, and always the first call. Scoped to the authenticated user (pass userId for a teammate) and accepts states.

tools.name: search-legislation
tools.description: Semantic search over state legislation documents. Returns bill_id for the bill tools.

tools.name: search-meetings
tools.description: Semantic natural-language transcript search. The fallback discovery tool when insights are thin.

tools.name: search-purchases
tools.description: Semantic search over purchase and contract-award records (purchase_dataset_id 1: federal contract awards with USAspending-style CONT_AWD ids; fields amount, vendor_name, department, purchase_description, transaction_date, organization_ids). Params query, daysBack, page, perPage (numbers). Returns total_hits, page, per_page, purchases[].

description_source: Tool matrix in plugins/cloverleaf-sales/skills/cloverleaf-mcp-operations/SKILL.md (verified 2026-08-18), plus live observation of the purchases tools on 2026-09-02.
